hypothesis: Frozen MOMENT plus all raw statistical features adds practical validation Macro-F1 beyond the strongest existing single-branch baseline at 20% and 40% training labels.
origin: Post-E01 exploratory hypothesis from seed 42; not a revision of the failed E01 low-label gate.
baseline_rule: For each seed and fraction, compare against the maximum validation Macro-F1 of the four frozen parent baseline results.

fixed_search.preprocessing: Original E01 fold-local BranchScaler; no new pooling, PCA, branch weighting, or model selection.

stop_policy: Complete all eight planned conditions regardless of intermediate outcomes; do not change thresholds, fractions, parameters, or seeds after inspecting replication results.
next_action: Summarize validation replication only. No automatic test evaluation or LoRA/full-finetuning launch.
limitations: Four remaining random splits are replications, not independent external data. Report descriptive uncertainty; seed 42 is discovery only. Validation labels have already been used by the parent comparison.
